intro: Public recognition for technical judging and community work.

featured.title: USAII Judges Appreciation Feature
featured.description: Featured by name, with title and photo, in the United States Artificial Intelligence Institute's public Judges Appreciation spotlight for the Global AI Hackathon, alongside senior industry peers.

featured.title: Signed Judging Credentials
featured.description: Received signed certificates and letters recognizing technical judging, including a Certificate of Mentoring & Judging from the HackMIT Co-Director and a Judge Confirmation and Appreciation Letter from InfinityX.

featured.title: Featured Alumni Speaker, Alumni Conclave 2026
featured.description: Invited back by St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering and Technology to speak at Alumni Conclave 2026 and share my professional journey with current students. The college featured the talk publicly to its audience of 11,000+ followers.
